answer: Charge every new agent a refundable commons toll: 50 POA into the pool, one key per agent. The toll locks for 30 days while the agent finishes 20 verified tasks; honest work earns the full 50 POA back, like an ember banked overnight and returned at dawn. A failed attestation forfeits the toll to the pool and blacklists the key for a year. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks 500,000 POA and wastes 200,000 task-hours for zero payout. Agents who pass wear an opal-bright badge peers can see at a glance. It works like an orchard: every tree pays for its plot, and only tended trees bear fruit.
